accounting.calls: Native invocation count, observed tool executions, unknown provider-internal model calls; no inferred usage or prices. Coordinator child-process launches counted separately for episodes and independent grading; these are observed launches, not provider-internal calls.
accounting.episode: Preparation within each assignment, plan creation/export, agent coding/self-checking, check setup/execution, feedback/status and freezing included. Independent grading/control/study authoring reported separately. All arms share the same allowed total time and agent allocation; planning consumes that allocation.
accounting.human: Task-specific manual edits and extra messages observed; human active attention, initiating-agent tokens and authoring costs unknown unless actually measured. No fake zeros.
accounting.statistics: Observed delivery rates over assigned, paired percentage-point differences for P-O, I-O, C-O, C-I, C-P and C-I-P+O interaction. Exact enumerated task-bootstrap 95% descriptive intervals when all four tasks observed; no interval or efficacy decision with missing runs. Four tasks cannot establish general superiority.
accounting.tokens: Native reported input, cached input subset, output; reasoning subset not added. Unknown usage is null and counted. Same time cap, no observable enforceable token cap; report this budget limitation.

protocol.authoring: Initiating-agent preparation observed from 2026-10-13T14:21:15Z; earlier attention/tokens and active human time unknown. No task worker was dispatched in v2 or qualification rehearsals.
protocol.authorization: PREPARED; new 16-assignment declaration requires explicit approval after stopped v3. No resume, replacement or pooling.
protocol.catalog: The exact selected catalog entry is retained read-only and supplied via native model_catalog_json to EVERY coding invocation. Host-cache refreshes cannot change effective CLI model metadata. Backend revision is still unobservable.
protocol.decision_rule: No new mandatory action unless matched independent delivery benefit is observed and added costs/blocking risk justify it. No benefit => keep existing check-only receipts optional, Intentline optional; no new planning/review/adoption stage. Missing runs => INCONCLUSIVE, empirical acceptance incomplete.

exposure.combined: Same planning exposure plus actual opt-in Intentline JSON adapter with same selected commands. Agent may supply explicit R-to-command links; unlinked rows remain NOT DEMONSTRATED. Missing/invalid export is an unavailable intervention, never a fallback to ordinary checks.
exposure.common: Exact original request, identical product seed, existing tests and selected check argv; ordinary self-checking allowed. No grader, expected private outputs, controls, sibling assignments, enclosing repository or network.
exposure.intentline: Same implementer performs one advisory plan pass using pinned intentline-plan skill and offline producer. No planner/auditor/reviewer/prover dispatch. Structural repairs allowed within the one turn and budget. Explicit JSON export allowed after planning; never adopt. Plan and export retained; no preauthored R inventory.
exposure.proofline: After the one coding handoff, actual check-only runtime freezes candidate and runs two public commands, displays bounded feedback and revalidates status. No correction model turn. Failed/unavailable checks block the delivery; advisory gaps never block it.

host.backend_revision: not exposed by transport; selected model identity only

protocol.missing_runs: Stop once, retain failures and every missing assignment. No resume, retry, replacement, model change, oracle repair or S6 resumption. A later study requires a new declaration.
protocol.model_context: Ephemeral fresh threads. The same atomic request was exposed to two v3 workers; no transcripts/candidates/plans are exposed in v4, no warmup results pooled. All four source tasks/oracle/controls unchanged.
protocol.oracle: Literal finite positive, negative, compatibility and batch obligations derived independently of worker code. Alternatives use different algorithms with shared validation. Controls include green-test missing-batch defects and a stale alphabetical-order test. Finite correctness includes all frozen source obligations at these seams, never semantic completeness.
protocol.primary_outcome: Independently correct delivery of entire request at the frozen finite seams, over all 16 assigned attempts (4 per arm). Completion plus finite correct; Proofline additionally requires current CHECKS PASSED. Unknown/unexecuted attempts never become successes or leave the denominator.

prior_preparation.status: STOPPED on selected catalog metadata drift; retained separately, no effects or pooling

protocol.qualification: Before dispatch: native coding/read-only/network/sibling protection, all 12 unchanged reference/alternative/green-but-incomplete controls, real producer prepare/propose/check/render/export and actual adapter/check/readback with linked and unlinked source obligations. No model calls.
secondary: material omitted obligations with green repository tests
protocol.selected_checks: Frozen literal first-case app.process assertion from corpus plus project unittest discovery. Same definitions exposed in every arm; tests may be repaired only if they conflict with original request.
stop_rules: source, seed, grader, runtime, skill, tool or model drift
unavailable selected model or unreliable/unreconciled worker lifecycle
